notes.title: Patch 1.2.2
notes.content: [p]While everyone else is polishing their mammoths for the Ukrainian Games Festival 2025, we’ve been busy hammering bugs and teaching bosses some manners. Here’s what’s new in this prehistoric upgrade: [/p][list][*][p]Feline Logic Restored,[/p][/*][*][p]Fashion stays after dying,[/p][/*][*][p]Boss Behavior Upgrade,[/p][/*][*][p]Punchier Combat Feel,[/p][/*][*][p]Multi OS, game now available on Mac & Linux,[/p][/*][/list][p] This patch is part of our celebration for Ukrainian Games Festival 2025 — a great excuse to update the game, squash some mammoth-sized bugs, and party like it’s 12,000 BC![/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.1
notes.content: [p]A few sneaky bugs got quietly squashed:[/p][p]- Ugh cannot be controlled while the Weapon/Clothes Selector is open right after the loading screen[/p][p]- Special Range attack is attacking specially again[/p][p]- The exploit with Spacesuit’s effects was removed[/p][p]- A bunch of NullReferenceExceptions were fixed[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311988/0b50f9d73bb3b4b7c03c52bd5be908b20ff1a814.png"][/img][/p][p]Welcome to Patch 1.2.0, where Ugr snores (but only once), pigs respect death, and swimming platforms finally stop launching into low orbit. We've cleaned up some dusty corners of the desert, taught our Nomad Leader some boundaries (and gave his push a proper punch), and finally made sure that if something looks dangerous - it [i]actually[/i] is. From hippos behaving as intended to enemy AI learning a bit of humility, this update is packed with juicy fixes and subtle polish to make your journey smoother, bloodier, and slightly less cursed.[/p][p][/p][p]Full changelog below - grab your tambourine (only after the right quest, of course) and dive in:[/p][list][*][p]The Hippo boss damages the player as expected [/p][/*][*][p]Pikeman's damage collider reduction (no more false hits)[/p][/*][*][p]Blood splatters added to notify about the stakes below[/p][/*][*][p]Now you can climb onto the Desert landing pad[/p][/*][*][p]The symbol of animals better reflects the objective of the Circus master[/p][/*][*][p]Ugr snores only once at the beginning of the game[/p][/*][*][p]Ugr's cave symbol on the wooden sign was changed[/p][/*][*][p]The Tambourine and the Rhi's Crown won't shine before the quests, during which we can pick them[/p][/*][*][p]Corrupted worm nest SFX fix[/p][/*][*][p]Smashable enemies won't damage you right after you land on them[/p][/*][*][p]Swimming platforms won’t fly away if you hit them underneath[/p][/*][*][p]Checkpoints can be activated again after you get new quests, new items (quest, weapon, clothes), and easter eggs[/p][/*][*][p]Flying enemies won't be stuck in the attack animation on a player's death[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies won’t respawn in front of the player[/p][/*][*][p]Movement controlled by the gamepad stick was improved[/p][/*][*][p]Resource quantity is displayed in the craft menus[/p][/*][*][p]The Pig won’t disappear after the player’s respawn[/p][/*][*][p]The Nomad Leader won’t go out of bounds[/p][/*][*][p]The Nomad Leader pushes will deal damage[/p][/*][*][p]Quest question mark will appear above the Old man after you find a bag[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a delay before you enter a portal[/p][/*][*][p]The Tentacle Monster won’t reappear after its death[/p][/*][*][p]Desert checkpoints fix[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor fixes[/p][/*][/list][p]If you’re enjoying the game, don’t forget to leave a review and share your feedback - it means the world to our small team and helps us keep making things better.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.10
notes.content:
First quick patch for some of the most frustrating issues:

[list]
[*] Hippo boss damage fix
[*] Pikeman damage collider reduction
[*] Added hints about stakes below
[*] Landing pad collider fix
[*] Animals symbol updates
[*] Minor cutscene fixes
[/list]

We'd love to hear from you about any other issues you may have in the comments to this post.

Enjoy the game!
